description:
Role and Responsibility 
 Hands on experience in working with industry known ETL tools e.g. Informatica, Talend, Kettle etc (Talend Preferred).
 Should be able to independently analyze and resolve production support issues within established Service Levels 
 Team player - clearly communicates commitments, issues, completion dates and status with the requestor and with management 
 Preferred experience 5 -7 years 
 
 Demonstrated Experience 
 Exposure to using automated scripts for some of the processes involved in data extraction and loading. 
 Should have done at least 3 implementation of ETL solution for reputed clients 
 Should be process oriented and be able to define processes and documents. 
 Should have strong knowledge on data warehousing concepts.
 Should have exposure to handling large volumes of data extraction and data loading in VLDB environment. 
 Exposure to handling data from various sources (Flat files, Excel, Access, Databases etc..) 
 Hands on experience in data cleansing, data auditing, data standardization/manipulation and data validation. 
 Exposure to using automated scripts for some of the processes involved in data extraction and loading. 
 Should possess strong analytical and SQL skills
 

 Apply today!
